interpretation: All nine newly passing PC cases fail the candidate SA threshold; they cannot add a Joint pass.
Three Joint losses are SA-threshold losses while PC still passes; the fourth is a PC-threshold loss with SA still passing. No Joint loss fails both thresholds.
PC gains among SA-passing cases remain genuine measured score gains; this regrouping neither validates their continuous physical process nor dismisses all PC gains.
This localizes the observed score bottleneck, not a proven causal architectural mechanism. Declared controls and B400 remain necessary.
